d.ko: 꼭 플레이해 봐야 하는 게임, 신규 3D 퍼즐 어드벤처 게임, The House of Da Vinci를 시작하세요.
d.en: Enter The House of Da Vinci, a new must-try 3D puzzle adventure game. Solve mechanical puzzles, discover hidden objects, escape from rooms and dive into the authentic atmosphere of the Renaissance. Use all your wits to find out what's behind your master's disappearance.
d.zh: 进入达芬奇房子，体验这个必须尝试的3D拼图冒险游戏。解决机械谜题，发现隐藏的物体，最后逃出房间。
